notes: Aligned (ALIGN) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory during launch. It has no owner, external mint or burn function, transfer tax, pause, blacklist, or upgrade mechanism. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs ALIGN with IMD. initialPrice is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply.
